download_oscar_dataset: run the script to download the OSCAR-2201 English dataset from HuggingFace using load_dataset
count_oscar_ids: run the script to count the total number of IDs in the OSCAR training split
find_duplicate_oscar_ids: run the script to find the most common duplicate IDs in the OSCAR dataset using Counter
load_oscar_with_auth: run the script to load the OSCAR dataset using a HuggingFace token from the HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN environment variable
save_oscar_to_disk: run the script to save the loaded OSCAR dataset to disk using save_to_disk
